moments.title: Cardiff City vs QPR Tonight
moments.blurb: Cardiff City are in action tonight against Queens Park Rangers in the Championship at Loftus Road.

angles.name: Match Preview
angles.copy: Big game tonight for Cardiff City! They face QPR away at Loftus Road. Kick-off is 7:45 PM. Can the Bluebirds grab an important three points on the road?

angles.name: Game Day Buzz
angles.copy: It's match day! Cardiff City are playing QPR this evening. Get behind the lads as they battle it out in the Championship.

moments.title: ELO's Mik Kaminski is 75
moments.blurb: Mik Kaminski, the iconic violinist from Electric Light Orchestra, celebrates his 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Violin Virtuoso
angles.copy: Happy 75th to Mik Kaminski! The legendary ELO violinist brought a classical touch to some of the biggest rock anthems. What's your favourite ELO track?

moments.title: Toto's Steve Porcaro turns 69
moments.blurb: Keyboardist and songwriter Steve Porcaro, a founding member of Toto and co-writer of Michael Jackson's 'Human Nature', celebrates his 69th birthday.

angles.name: Toto Talent
angles.copy: From 'Africa' to 'Rosanna', Steve Porcaro's keys defined the Toto sound. Wishing the keyboard legend a very happy 69th birthday!

moments.title: The Beach Boys' Al Jardine is 84
moments.blurb: Al Jardine, a co-founder and rhythm guitarist of the legendary Beach Boys, celebrates his 84th birthday tomorrow.

angles.name: Good Vibrations
angles.copy: Sending good vibrations to Al Jardine of The Beach Boys, who turns 84 tomorrow! What's your favourite surf rock anthem from the band?

moments.title: Sex Pistols' Steve Jones turns 71
moments.blurb: Steve Jones, the influential guitarist of punk pioneers the Sex Pistols, celebrates his 71st birthday tomorrow.

angles.name: Punk Icon
angles.copy: Anarchy in the UK! Happy 71st birthday tomorrow to Steve Jones, the legendary guitarist who helped define punk rock with the Sex Pistols.

moments.title: Beyoncé turns 45
moments.blurb: Global superstar Beyoncé celebrates her 45th birthday on Friday, continuing her reign as one of music's most powerful voices.

angles.name: Queen Bey's Birthday
angles.copy: All hail Queen Bey! Beyoncé turns 45 on Friday. What's your ultimate Beyoncé power anthem?

angles.name: Celebrating an Icon
angles.copy: From Destiny's Child to global icon, Beyoncé celebrates her 45th this Friday. Her influence on music and culture is undeniable. What's your favourite era of Queen Bey?

moments.title: Pink Floyd's Roger Waters is 83
moments.blurb: Roger Waters, a co-founder and primary songwriter of Pink Floyd, celebrates his 83rd birthday on Sunday.

angles.name: Pink Floyd Legend
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to Pink Floyd's Roger Waters this Sunday! A true visionary who gave us some of rock's most profound albums.

moments.title: Macy Gray turns 57
moments.blurb: Soulful singer Macy Gray, known for her distinctive voice and hits like 'I Try', celebrates her 57th birthday on Sunday.

angles.name: Unique Voice
angles.copy: Nobody sounds quite like Macy Gray! Wishing the incredible singer a very happy 57th birthday this Sunday. What's your favourite track from her?

moments.title: Strictly Come Dancing Pre-Record
moments.blurb: The launch show for the new series of Strictly Come Dancing is set to be pre-recorded next Wednesday, with a new line-up of hosts and celebrity dancers.

angles.name: Strictly's Back
angles.copy: The glitterball is getting polished! Strictly Come Dancing's launch show is pre-recording next Wednesday. Who are you hoping to see on the dance floor this year?

angles.name: New Hosts Alert
angles.copy: Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe are taking over Strictly hosting duties! The launch show pre-records next Wednesday – get ready for new energy and dazzling dances.

moments.title: P!nk turns 47
moments.blurb: Pop-rock powerhouse P!nk, known for her anthems and acrobatic live shows, celebrates her 47th birthday on Tuesday.

angles.name: Get The Party Started
angles.copy: Get the party started! P!nk turns 47 on Tuesday. What's your all-time favourite P!nk track?

moments.title: Cardiff City vs Stoke City
moments.blurb: Cardiff City will host Stoke City in a Championship clash next Tuesday at Cardiff City Stadium.

angles.name: Home Game Hype
angles.copy: Next Tuesday, Cardiff City are back home to face Stoke City! Get your tickets and make some noise for the Bluebirds at Cardiff City Stadium.

moments.title: Aerosmith's Joe Perry is 76
moments.blurb: Joe Perry, the legendary lead guitarist of rock giants Aerosmith, celebrates his 76th birthday on Thursday.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Icon
angles.copy: Walk This Way! Wishing a very happy 76th birthday to Aerosmith's incredible guitarist, Joe Perry, this Thursday. What's your favourite Aerosmith riff?

moments.title: Siobhan Fahey turns 68
moments.blurb: Siobhan Fahey, known for her work with Bananarama and Shakespears Sister, celebrates her 68th birthday on Thursday.

angles.name: Pop Queen
angles.copy: From 'Venus' to 'Stay', Siobhan Fahey has given us so many iconic tracks! Happy 68th birthday to the Bananarama and Shakespears Sister star this Thursday.

moments.title: The Verve's Richard Ashcroft is 55
moments.blurb: Richard Ashcroft, the charismatic frontman of The Verve and successful solo artist, celebrates his 55th birthday on Friday.

angles.name: Mad Richard
angles.copy: The 'Drugs Don't Work' hitmaker, Richard Ashcroft, turns 55 this Friday! What's your favourite Verve song or solo track from Mad Richard?

moments.title: Moby turns 61
moments.blurb: Electronic music pioneer Moby, known for his groundbreaking albums like 'Play', celebrates his 61st birthday on Friday.

angles.name: Electronic Genius
angles.copy: Feeling 'Porcelain'? Moby turns 61 this Friday! The electronic music legend has soundtracked countless moments. What's your top Moby tune?

moments.title: Great British Bake Off Returns
moments.blurb: The Great British Bake Off is set to return to Channel 4 this September, with new judge Nigella Lawson joining Paul Hollywood. The premiere is expected on Tuesday, September 29.

angles.name: Bake Off Buzz
angles.copy: Get ready to pre-heat your ovens! The Great British Bake Off returns this September to Channel 4, with Nigella Lawson joining the judging panel. Who's excited for soggy bottoms and showstoppers?

angles.name: New Judge in the Tent
angles.copy: Nigella Lawson is joining Paul Hollywood in the Bake Off tent! The new series kicks off late September on Channel 4. What bakes are you hoping to see this year?
